integrity: The universal statement is proved by exhausting the ten possible ordered divisor-count pairs for \(\Omega\le3\). The included finite enumeration through \(10^6\) is only a regression check and is not used as a proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to inputs with \(\Omega(n)\le3\); no global classification of primitive or higher-almost-prime collisions is claimed.
title: The unique collision of \(n\tau(n)\) among \(3\)-almost-primes
